```python
def prefix_match_mask(values: np.ndarray, prefix: str) -> np.ndarray:
    """Vectorised ``str(value).startswith(prefix)`` over canonical spellings."""
    count = values.size
    if count == 0:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=bool)
    if not prefix:
        return np.ones(count, dtype=bool)
    match = np.zeros(count, dtype=bool)
    target = int(prefix)
    length = len(prefix)
    for digits in range(1, 8):
        low = 0 if digits == 1 else 10 ** (digits - 1)
        high = 9 if digits == 1 else 10 ** digits - 1
        if digits < length:
            continue
        selected = (values >= low) & (values <= high)
        if not selected.any():
            continue
        match |= selected & ((values // 10 ** (digits - length)) == target)
    return match
```
